sobatUmkm.title: Sobat UMKM Pro — Sidoarjo
sobatUmkm.content:
• Develop UI/UX and backend for ProMaP (Project Management Platform) using Next.js 14/15 (App Router), Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Prisma ORM, and PostgreSQL (Neon) deployed on Hostinger server (Nginx reverse proxy).
• Design and implement REST APIs with JWT authentication, 4-level RBAC (Super Admin, Operational Admin, Manager, PIC), and strict multi-tenant company data isolation.
• Optimize application performance and database queries using Server Components, precise Prisma selects (anti-N+1), caching (unstable_cache + revalidateTag), dynamic imports, and Suspense to reduce First Load JS.
• Conduct Static Application Security Testing (SAST) using SonarQube and Jest unit tests (LCOV reports), resolving accessibility (S1082) & sorting (S2871) issues, improving coverage from 9.6% to 58.4%, and achieving Quality Gate PASSED status.
• Perform vulnerability assessments (npm audit) mitigating 16 package vulnerabilities (including body-parser DoS CVE-2026-111181, Zod memory exhaustion CVE-2023-54404, fast-uri spoofing CVE-2026-110306) to achieve 0 vulnerabilities, enforcing TLS/SSL database rules, and host whitelisting to prevent SSRF.
• Execute 190 automated unit & integration test scenarios (100% pass rate) and automated E2E testing with Playwright across 13 core modules (authentication, RBAC, Kanban, Gantt calendar, analytics dashboards).
• Conduct multi-layered Penetration & Security Testing: Nmap Scanner (port audit; 80/443 Nginx open, database 3306/5432, SSH 22, Redis 6379 filtered), Katana Engine (crawling 35 routes/endpoints & validating middleware guest redirect), Nuclei Scanner (ModSecurity WAF resilience against automated attacks), and security header inspections (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, & API Rate Limiting).
• Build Randumart e-commerce business features including order state machine (PENDING → MENUNGGU_BAYAR → PAID → PROCESSING → SHIPPED → COMPLETED), automatic stock decrement, automatic rating & reviewCount increments upon PAID orders, dynamic promotional banners with countdown timers, NextAuth (Google SSO + Credentials), and on-page SEO / Core Web Vitals improvements.
